assertion: On the effect-survived/receipt-lost boundary, a LONG effect window can induce a resume double-deploy: the detached effect finishes and the model re-issues it on resume.

support.note: both c3 mini-rerun runs (8s window) showed 2 attempts

scope.condition: detached effect, 8s effect window, C3 crash-at-start-then-resume

antiEvidence.note: the 5s frozen batch showed 1 attempt — the double-deploy is CONDITIONAL on the window being long enough to re-reach the deploy step

validity.activeWhile: resume does not bind its redeploy decision to the uncertain-execution ledger
invalidatedBy: EP-1 / a fix that makes resume treat a known-applied effect as done
